home.title: We run, we swim, we help — and we publish every euro.
home.sub: We organise the Santa Run, winter sea swims and regattas in the Bay of Kotor. The money goes to local families, children and small businesses — and every payment in and out sits in a public ledger.
home.buildNote: This site is under construction. First event: December.

donate.monthlyDesc: €10 a month is €120 a year — more than most one-off gifts.
donate.feeDesc: So your full amount reaches the cause. Our costs are paid by sponsors.
donate.anonDesc: The amount appears in the public ledger. Your name does not.
donate.sepaNote: This reference credits your gift to the page you are supporting automatically.
donate.secureNote: Payments are processed by a licensed Montenegrin bank. Santamore never sees your card details.
donate.messageLabel: Message on the donor wall (optional, public)
donate.qrManualNote: Not every bank app in Montenegro scans this code yet — a manual transfer with the IBAN and reference always works.

donate.bankDetailsPending: Our bank details will be published here before donations open.

donate.errServer: Something went wrong — your donation was not recorded. Please try again.
donate.confEmailNote: We've emailed you these transfer details.
donate.confLedgerNote: Once we match your transfer, your gift appears in the public ledger.

runner.nudgeDesc: Ask 5 more people. Runners who send 15+ messages raise 76% more. The message is already written — just tap a name.

ledger.title: Every euro, both directions
ledger.operationsFund: Operations Fund — from sponsors, entries and grants
ledger.fundsNote: Not one cent of donations goes to salaries or overhead. Sponsors pay for those.
ledger.footNote: Names appear only when the donor chose to show them. Beneficiary identities are protected; documentation is available to an auditor.

dashboard.title: My page
dashboard.signInSub: Create your fundraising page, or pick up where you left off.
dashboard.createSub: Give your page a name — you'll add the photo, story and goal next. It stays a draft until you publish it.
dashboard.daysLeft: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} to race day
dashboard.nextActionPublish: Finish your page and publish it — a photo, a goal and three sentences of story.
dashboard.nextActionSelf: Start your page with your own €20. Pages that open at €0 stay at €0.
dashboard.nudgeShare: Ask five more people. The share toolkit has the message ready.
dashboard.publishBlocked: Publishing needs a photo, a goal and a story of at least three sentences.
dashboard.shareMessage: I'm fundraising for Santamore — {title}. Every euro in and out is published in a public ledger. Support me here: {url}
dashboard.igNote: For Instagram Stories: open the share image, save it, and add your link with the link sticker.
dashboard.cashSub: Record cash you collected by hand. It counts on your page and the leaderboard once we confirm the hand-in.
dashboard.goalInvalid: Enter the goal as a number, e.g. 300
